[NERR.6.2] A `ds_fact_t *` held across pumps is valid only while its fact is
live ([NFCT.6.2]). An integrator that holds one **must** drop it at the fact's
`DS_EV_FACT_RETRACT`, or re-derive identity from the source state. A handle
used after its fact left working memory is undefined behaviour, which no status
reports; `DS_ERR_FACT_INVALID` is not that report ([IDAT.1.6]).
